notes.title: Progress
notes.content:
It has been 3 days since I clicked that publish button.  So far, so good. 24 wish lists and 1300 page visits, which is really not half bad. 
 [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35745857/db23047442e3563e1c32d6d56b5ea3f35100ad89.png[/img]

That said work on Update one has begun!

update 1 will include
[list]
[*] A variety of bug fixes.
[*] More Traps and locations to visit in the story morde as well as over all beautification of the landscape.
[*] Performance boosts!
[*] A considerable number of challenge levels.  The Current goal is 50 short but difficult levels to in general frustrate the player into sending me hate mail.
[*] built in controller support.
[*] Steam Achievements!

What I would like to put in

[*] Cloud Saving
[*] Intro videos to each story mode level.  This is a bit difficult for me as I would be forced to delay possession or figure out a new trigger event to control all the start up logic.
[/list]

Thanks for reading my first announcement!
